name: wise-hirehop-proposal-platform
purpose: Wise internal HireHop enhancement package for proposal authoring, staging kit design, document preview, native item workflow helpers, capacity tracking, and QTC renderer alignment.

activeScripts.role: Shared HireHop selectors, endpoint paths, depot rules, retry timings, search helpers, and tree item prefixes consumed by the section builder and capacity tracker.
Document preview panel used by power users and by the page editor preview dock.
Small native-popup helper for repetitive line item selection actions.
Shared WisePageMeta and editor/template identifier contract consumed by the section builder and aligned to the QTC renderer.
Shared proposal page/layout catalogue consumed by the section builder.
Main proposal page editor and HireHop authoring layer.
Full-page Wise capacity timeline using project-level custom fields, date-range filtering, Wise status controls, and sanitized absence overlay support.

Simple metric/imperial staging designer that caches live HireHop hire stock plus imperial sales consumables, adds the required small/medium/large staging box by deck count, limits carpet/fascia colour choices to exact live stock colours with a custom colour fallback, imports stage rows under a generated heading that includes 3/4 sided fascia, and keeps carpet to one combined stage-top/tread row.

Project and job page UI polish that hides Billing and Purchase orders tabs for non-admin users across all depots, keeps them visible for admin users, and adds a native Checklist tab panel with placeholder project/job checklist fields.

referenceFiles.role: Copy of the renderer already deployed in HireHop; useful locally for alignment checks.

legacyFiles.role: V1 concept editor superseded by sectionbuilder2.
Older section builder snapshot retained as a manual rollback reference.
